plan_errors.plan_location: Section 0 D11 rejected-alternatives cell (:40), Phase 5 draft for :664 (:302-303), Section 3.3 row 1201 (:458 "W: add the regime clause (cube excluded the copies)")
plan_errors.claim: "Its 25 Å cube centred on the reference kept the other copies outside Vina's search" and "its Vina anchor was inert only because the 25 Å cube excluded the copies".
plan_errors.correction: False as a universal statement. Recomputed from Data/PoseBuster Benchmark Set/<id>/<id>_ligands.sdf (scratch /tmp/.../wf2/copies_datacheck.csv): 16 of the 143 multi-copy ids have an alternate with at least one heavy atom inside the 25 Å cube centred on the reference centroid (6YJA_2BA, 6YYO_Q1K, 7A9E_R4W, 7AFX_R9K, 7CD9_FVR, 7ED2_A3P, 7JY3_VUD, 7KM8_WPD, 7O0N_CDP, 7ODY_DGI, 7TSF_H4B, 7UJ5_DGL, 7UXS_OJC, 7VKZ_NOJ, 7WL4_JFU, 7Z1Q_NIO), 8 of them with the alternate centroid inside. The paper's own Vina rows (posebusters_paper_results.csv, post-processing none, 308 ids) score 57.3 % RMSD<=2 on multi-copy ids against 61.8 % on single-copy ids. The drafted thesis sentence must be softened to "kept most other copies outside" or quantified (16 of 143 reachable), and the D11 rationale should not rest on the cube making the convention inert.

plan_errors.plan_location: Section 0 D4 (:33) "verify once that membership agrees when tested against every copy"; Section 7 "Metal-adjacent stratum size 78 (D4)"
plan_errors.claim: Stratum membership is expected to agree across copies, so a single verification step suffices and the 78 is unchanged.
plan_errors.correction: The verification was run here (element-based metal set, 5 Å from any heavy atom of the copy, protein.pdb HETATM records) and membership does NOT agree for two analysed ids. 7JHQ_VAJ: reference copy 2.42 Å from a metal, its three alternates 21.8 / 22.5 / 39.5 Å away (centroid separations 37.1 / 28.8 / 42.9 Å). 7TB0_UD1: reference 9.04 Å from the nearest metal (outside the stratum), alternate 1 sits 3.17 Å from a Na+ (HETATM NA in 7TB0_UD1_protein.pdb). Both ids carry headline-arm poses within 2 Å of an alternate in nearest_copy_alldepths.csv (7JHQ_VAJ: 5 autodock_mgltools_exh128 + 5 autodock_mgltools_exh128_gnina + 3 unidock2 poses; 7TB0_UD1: 3 diffdock + 3 diffdock_smina poses). The plan needs a recorded decision on how a pose scored against a copy in the other stratum is counted in the stratum rates at body_main_short.tex:868 and body_appendix_short.tex:165, not a presumed-to-pass check. Note the element-based definition yields 77 of 303 (79 of 308), not 78, so the unregistered generator's exact rule is still unknown; borderline reference distances: 7CL8_TES 4.63, 7MSR_DCA 4.53, 7TOM_5AD 4.86, 8HO0_3ZI 4.64, 7OP9_06K 5.26, 7LOU_IFM 5.37 Å.

plan_errors.claim: "138 of them among the 303 analysed complexes, and the nearest other copy lies a median 36.0 Å from the reference."
plan_errors.correction: 36.0 Å is the per-id nearest-alternate median over the 143 multi-copy ids of the 308 (recomputed 35.98). Over the 138 analysed ids it is 36.3 Å, and over all 211 alternates 40.4 Å. The sentence pairs the 303 denominator with the 308-basis median; state the basis or use 36.3 Å.

plan_errors.claim: "Fig 30 panel A already shows the 46 % multi-instance share".
plan_errors.correction: Not verifiable in the short build. grep for "instanc" in body_appendix_short.tex hits only :664, :666 and :1218; the receptor-profile caption at :778 (fig:appendix-dataset-9) reads "Resolved residues, chains per complex, distinct cofactor types and ligand-versus-receptor size" and no dataset caption (:676-:789) names ligand instances or copies. plan_errors.claim: The X-ray control is unaffected because it busts the deposited ligand with no reference and no RMSD.
plan_errors.correction: The control busts only `<id>_ligand.sdf` (_build_xray_control_notebook.py:283 `lig = BENCH / i / f"{i}_ligand.sdf"`, :503 `_buster.bust(lig, None, prot, ...)`), one instance per entry. Under the new endpoint 211 alternate instances become admissible references that the control never busted, so the control's ceiling no longer covers every reference the endpoint can select. The hub-script inventory itself flags "Optional: bust all copies too, so the ceiling covers the instances that now count as correct". Section 7 should either move this to Phase 7 as an extension or record a scope caveat.

plan_errors.claim: "under that same nearest-copy scoring the published DiffDock rate is 31.5 % on the 143 multi-copy ids against 43.6 % on the 165 single-copy ids" (offered as evidence the convention is live for blind methods).
plan_errors.correction: The paper's Vina rows show the same direction under the 25 Å cube the plan calls inert: 57.3 % on multi-copy against 61.8 % on single-copy ids. Part of the multi/single gap is therefore a difficulty confound (multi-copy entries are larger oligomers), not a convention effect. If the DiffDock gap is quoted, the Vina gap should be quoted beside it or the inference dropped.
